Using while low < high instead of while low <= high causing the algorithm to skip checking the last remaining candidate element.
Failing to track whether any swaps occurred during a pass causing O(n^2) time even on already sorted arrays.
Swapping element values inside the inner loop during comparison rather than tracking min_idx and swapping once per outer iteration.
Overwriting elements forward during shifting without saving the key element or placing key at mid - 1 instead of j + 1.
Creating fresh list slices like arr[:mid] inside recursive calls rather than passing index pointers low and high resulting in excessive memory usage.
Incrementing the main array pointer without advancing the left or right sub-array pointer causing infinite duplicate writes.
Including the pivot index in both recursive sub-arrays (e.g. quicksort(arr, low, pivot) instead of pivot - 1) causing stack overflow.
Not incrementing the smaller element boundary i before swapping with j leading to incorrect element placement around the pivot.
Using 2*i and 2*i + 1 for child indices in a 0-indexed array instead of 2*i + 1 and 2*i + 2 causing index out-of-bounds errors.
